Generate a complete endless runner game spec.

Required fields:
- scroll_direction
- camera_mode
- lane_model
- movement_model
- primary_input
- obstacle_model
- collectible_model
- powerup_model
- difficulty_curve
- failure_condition

Also include:
- exact world scroll behavior
- exact player control mapping
- exact obstacle spawn categories
- exact score loop
- exact fail loop
- exact domain systems required

Architecture:
- React UI only
- PixiJS rendering
- fixed-step deterministic domain simulation
- no gameplay logic in React
